findings.claim: FY2023–FY2025 10-K 揭露：無任何單一客戶占淨營收及財務收入超過 5.0%，客戶營收基礎高度分散。
findings.excerpt: We have a highly fragmented customer revenue base given the large numbers of sellers and buyers who use our platforms. For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, no single customer accounted for more than 5.0% of our net revenues and financial income.

findings.claim: 財報附註：信用風險無重大集中；2025/2024 年底除信用卡處理公司外，無單一客戶占應收帳款及放款超過 5%；信用卡應收款曝險對象在各國不超過 10 家機構。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 財報附註 Concentration of credit risk
findings.excerpt: As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, no single customer, except for credit card processing companies, accounted for more than 5% of accounts receivable and loans receivable. Credit card receivables and other means of payments, net line of the consolidated balance sheets shows the Company’s credit exposure to not more than 10 entities in each of the countries where the Company offers its payments solution.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 僅採用程式提供的一手摘錄，未另行搜尋；客戶自身信用惡化事件（破產/降評）未查。
